post.summary: Kling lip-sync API — sync a character's mouth in a video to audio or text.

example.detail: one of video_id or video_url is required

400.description: Request error, it may be due to missing or invalid parameters.

401.description: Unauthorized, authorization token is invalid or missing.

500.description: Internal server error, an exception occurred on the server side.

post.description: Use audio or text to drive an existing Kling video (5 seconds or 10 seconds), allowing the characters within to sync their speech (lip-syncing). This can be combined with the image2video from /kling/videos to form a complete "talking photo" process.

mode.description: audio2video: Drive with audio clips; text2video: Drive with text + tone.

text.description: Text to be read aloud (required when mode is text2video, up to 120 characters).

async.description: Return task_id immediately when true; you can poll through /kling/tasks or receive callbacks to get the result.

video_id.description: The ID of the video generated by Kling (for example, from /kling/videos image2video) must be generated within the last 30 days. Choose one of video_url or this.

voice_id.description: The tone used (required when mode is text2video).

audio_url.description: The public URL for the audio drive (required when mode is audio2video).

video_url.description: The public URL of the 5-second/10-second video that matches the lip sync. Choose one between video_id.

audio_file.description: Base64 of the audio file (required when audio_type is file). Supports .mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac, not exceeding 5MB.

audio_type.description: The method of providing audio (for audio2video).

voice_speed.description: The speech rate of text2video (0.8–2.0, keep one decimal place).

callback_url.description: If provided (or async=true), it will immediately return task_id and push the result via callback when ready.
